svg.text: nanoshm: from nanopore reads to somatic hypermutation calls
The workflow behind the J꜀4 results, step by step: preset jh4_intron, mode recommended, three wild-type and three Aicda−/− libraries.
Counts in the boxes are from those six libraries, run on 12 October 2026.

Every read's base and quality at every position; each different base seen is a candidate.
A base carried by ≥ 50% of reads is the mouse's own sequence, not a mutation: removed (5 positions).
Rank the k supporting reads by base quality, q(1) ≥ q(2) ≥ … ≥ q(k). For each j, how likely are j or more
miscalls of quality ≥ q(j) at this depth? X ~ Poisson(depth × inflated miscall rate at ≥ q(j)).
p = k × min over j of P(X ≥ j)
Across every candidate in the library; homopolymer runs ≥ 4 are flagged, not removed.
